states.collected: Lambo's daily run collects market data for the narrative's members.
states.collection_paused: Collection stopped (for example a replacement at the six-narrative cap). Memberships stay open; pages stay reachable; gaps after the pause are shown as gaps.
states.retired: The defining source is gone or contradicted. Memberships close with the reason.

lifecycle.featured: Featured placement (homepage, at most six) and collection priority are separate from lifecycle and from factual membership.
lifecycle.trend: For collected narratives: 'rising' when 7-day volume of the same basket is >= 25% above the prior 7 days, 'fading' when <= -25%, otherwise 'steady'; 'new' when first observed within 7 days. Computed on the current basket and labelled so.

membership.factual: A coin's membership is an evidence-backed classification of what the coin is (name, metadata or official source naming the story). It is not affiliation with a named project or person.
membership.intervals: Each interval has a unique id (narrative:token@start), its effective start, when it was recorded, and (only for factual exits) its end. Collection pauses and inactivity archive a member without ending the interval.
membership.reconstructed: Members added with historicalMembershipBasis=reconstructed_today were classified when first observed; volume before that date is today's classification applied backwards.

metrics.volumeShare: Share of the narrative's measured volume by member (all indexed pools per token, Codex getTokenBars). Market-volume share, not social attention.
metrics.concentration: top1Share and Herfindahl-Hirschman index (sum of squared shares, 0-10000) of member volume over the window.
metrics.breadth: Members with a positive 7-day price return / members with prices at both ends; the denominator is shown.
metrics.attention: X results are a top-results convenience sample: counts of posts are reported only as 'posts found in N searches', never as mindshare.
metrics.evidence: Project claims (official pages and posts), independent evidence (news, third-party reporting) and observed on-chain behavior are listed separately. Reposts or quotes of one claim count once.

dedup: Market totals across narratives count each token once; the overlap (tokens in more than one narrative) is listed with its volume.
capitalFlows: Turnover and market-cap changes are not net capital inflows; no inflow figures are published.
